reading.zh: 从左到右：auth 先鉴权，responses 提供响应写出助手，get-routes 处理只读查询，post-routes 处理命令写入；箭头是一次请求的通过顺序。
reading.en: Left to right: auth authorizes first, responses supplies the writer helpers, get-routes serves read-only queries and post-routes serves commands; the arrows are the order one request passes through.
